title: Canonical local pure tensors for sheaf scalar extension
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with object universe $u_C$, morphism universe $v_C$, and $C$ essentially small in the coefficient universe $w$; assume forgetting commutative ring sheaves to ring sheaves preserves the sheaf condition. For a commutative ring sheaf $R$ with values in $w$, let $\operatorname{ScalarExtensionConstraintModules}(R)$ be the existing category of sheaves of modules over its underlying ring sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $M,N$ in this category, $U\in C$, and sections $x\in M(U)$, $y\in N(U)$, define $\operatorname{scalarExtensionConstraintPureTensor}(R,M,N,U,x,y)$ to be the image of $x\otimes y$ under the module-sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], then the inverse of the canonical comparison from the existing tensor object to the sheafified sectionwise tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For a map $\alpha:A\to S$ of commutative ring sheaves, an $A$-module sheaf $H$, and $h\in H(U)$, $s\in S(U)$, define $\operatorname{scalarExtensionConstraintTmul}(\alpha,H,U,h,s)$ to be the image of $s\otimes_{A(U),\alpha_U}h$ under the module-sheafification unit into the existing change-of-rings sheaf [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. No flatness hypothesis or scalar-extension coherence theorem is part of this definition.
